name: Microwave Masoor Dal
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) red lentils (masoor), rinsed
Tadka: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp cumin seeds, 2 garlic cloves (sliced), 1 dried red chilli, pinch of hing
steps: Place the lentils, water, turmeric and tomato in a large microwave-safe bowl. Cover loosely.
Microwave on high for 5 minutes, then at 50% for 12 minutes until completely soft. Stir twice.
Whisk the dal and add salt.
For the tadka, microwave the oil, cumin, garlic, chilli and hing in a small bowl for 1 minute until sizzling.
Pour over the dal and finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: Red lentils need no soaking, which suits the microwave.
